description_en: Exports the list of shared cloud desktops and saves it as an XLSX file. Each shared cloud desktop record includes the shared cloud desktop ID and name, office network ID and name, shared cloud desktop template, and security policy name
description_zh: 调用本接口导出的共享型云电脑列表将保存为XLSX文件。每条共享型云电脑数据包括共享型云电脑ID和名称、办公网络ID和名称、共享型云电脑模板、安全策略名称等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd export-desktop-group-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4676710000 --desktop-group-name CloudComputerPool01 --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --policy-group-id pg-53iyi2aar0nd60000 --charge-type PrePaid --expired-time 2022-12-31T15:59Z --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --end-user-id alice --lang-type zh-CN --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportDesktopGroupInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office network to which the shared cloud desktops belong
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the shared cloud desktop
parameters.name: desktop_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.    

- Maximum value: 100.
- Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。    

- 最大值：100。
- 默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. An empty value indicates that no more results exist
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy associated with the shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑关联的策略ID
parameters.name: policy_group_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的计费方式
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the subscription shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月共享型云电脑的到期时间
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The list of shared cloud desktop IDs
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized user IDs for the shared cloud desktops
parameters.help_zh: 共享型云电脑的授权用户ID列表
parameters.name: end_user_id

element_fields.help_en: The tag key. This parameter cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
